name: filter-polish-f4e99090
description: Полировка редактора отбора, часть 2 (ошибка f4e99090; пункты 1, 2, 3, 6): онбординг → «Структуры» → DOM-пробы. П.1 — геометрия SVG-стрелок «Родители» (вниз) / «Потомки» (вверх). П.2 — замер padding/шрифта сегментного переключателя строки. П.3 — отсутствие переключателя режимов у ТИПА мысли под «в иерархии». П.6 — layout строки: части по верху, блок значения переносится целиком, крестик в правом верхнем углу при разной ширине; обе темы. Запуск: node client/scripts/ui-probe-stand.mjs --scenario client/scripts/ui-probe.filter-polish-f4e99090.scenario.json --out .tmp/etn-f4e99090/out

steps.name: panel-to-max
steps.eval: (() => { const s = document.querySelector('.st-filter + .fp-splitter') || document.querySelector('.fp-splitter'); if (!s) return 'no-splitter'; s.focus(); s.dispatchEvent(new KeyboardEvent('keydown', { key: 'End', bubbles: true })); return true; })()

steps.name: add-condition
steps.eval: (() => { const btn = document.querySelector('.st-filter .ft-add-condition'); if (btn) btn.click(); return document.querySelectorAll('.st-filter .ft-row').length; })()

steps.name: arrow-geometry
steps.probe: (() => { const pick = (k) => { const it = document.querySelector('.ft-choice__item[data-key="' + k + '"]'); const svg = it ? it.querySelector('svg') : null; return svg ? [...svg.querySelectorAll('path')].map((p) => p.getAttribute('d')).join(' | ') : null; }; return JSON.stringify({ parents: pick('parents'), children: pick('children') }); })()

steps.name: arrows-not-swapped
steps.probe: (() => { const p = document.querySelector('.ft-choice__item[data-key="parents"] svg'); const c = document.querySelector('.ft-choice__item[data-key="children"] svg'); const d = (svg) => svg ? [...svg.querySelectorAll('path')].map((x) => x.getAttribute('d')).join(' ') : ''; const pd = d(p); const cd = d(c); const parentsDown = /v14|19 12-7 7/.test(pd); const childrenUp = /19V5|m5 12 7-7 7 7/.test(cd); return parentsDown && childrenUp; })()

steps.name: type-mode-absent-probe
steps.probe: (() => { const row = document.querySelector('.st-filter .ft-row'); const kind = row ? row.querySelector('.ft-row__what').textContent.trim() : null; const op = row ? row.querySelector('.ft-row__op')?.textContent?.trim() ?? null : null; return JSON.stringify({ kind, op, fvModeCount: row ? row.querySelectorAll('.fv-mode').length : -1, fvCount: row ? row.querySelectorAll('.fv').length : -1 }); })()

steps.name: type-mode-absent-assert
steps.probe: (() => { const row = document.querySelector('.st-filter .ft-row'); if (!row) return false; const kind = row.querySelector('.ft-row__what').textContent.trim(); const op = row.querySelector('.ft-row__op')?.textContent?.trim() ?? ''; return kind.includes('Тип мысли') && op.includes('иерархии') && row.querySelectorAll('.fv-mode').length === 0; })()

steps.name: switch-tokens-baseline
steps.probe: (() => { const cs = getComputedStyle(document.documentElement); return JSON.stringify({ padY_token: cs.getPropertyValue('--control-pad-y').trim(), padX_token: cs.getPropertyValue('--space-5').trim() }); })()

steps.name: switch-metrics
steps.probe: (() => { const sw = document.querySelector('.st-filter .ft-row .fv-mode'); if (!sw) return 'no-switch'; const seg = sw.querySelector('.ui-btn') || sw; const cs = getComputedStyle(seg); const r = seg.getBoundingClientRect(); return JSON.stringify({ padTop: cs.paddingTop, padRight: cs.paddingRight, padBottom: cs.paddingBottom, padLeft: cs.paddingLeft, fontSize: cs.fontSize, w: Math.round(r.width), h: Math.round(r.height) }); })()

steps.name: switch-compact-assert
steps.probe: (() => { const sw = document.querySelector('.st-filter .ft-row .fv-mode'); if (!sw) return false; const seg = sw.querySelector('.ui-btn'); if (!seg) return false; const cs = getComputedStyle(seg); const px = (v) => Math.round(parseFloat(v) * 100) / 100; const padY = px(cs.paddingTop); const padX = px(cs.paddingRight); const fs = px(cs.fontSize); return padY <= 2.5 && padX <= 5.5 && fs <= 12; })()

steps.name: row-align-items
steps.probe: (() => { const row = document.querySelector('.st-filter .ft-row'); return row ? getComputedStyle(row).alignItems : null; })()

steps.name: row-align-assert
steps.probe: (() => { const row = document.querySelector('.st-filter .ft-row'); return row ? getComputedStyle(row).alignItems === 'flex-start' : false; })()

steps.name: ensure-max
steps.eval: (() => { const s = document.querySelector('.st-filter + .fp-splitter') || document.querySelector('.fp-splitter'); if (!s) return 'no-splitter'; s.focus(); s.dispatchEvent(new KeyboardEvent('keydown', { key: 'End', bubbles: true })); return true; })()

steps.name: layout-wide
steps.probe: (() => { const row = document.querySelector('.st-filter .ft-row'); const q = (c) => row.querySelector(c); const top = (e) => e ? Math.round(e.getBoundingClientRect().top) : null; const what = q('.ft-row__what'); const op = q('.ft-row__op'); const val = q('.ft-row__value'); const rm = q('.ft-row__remove'); const rr = row.getBoundingClientRect(); const rmr = rm ? rm.getBoundingClientRect() : null; return JSON.stringify({ rowW: Math.round(rr.width), whatTop: top(what), opTop: top(op), valueTop: top(val), sameLine: top(what) === top(op) && top(what) === top(val), crossTopDelta: rmr ? Math.round(rmr.top - rr.top) : null, crossRightDelta: rmr ? Math.round(rr.right - rmr.right) : null }); })()

steps.name: layout-wide-one-line
steps.probe: (() => { const row = document.querySelector('.st-filter .ft-row'); const t = (c) => { const e = row.querySelector(c); return e ? Math.round(e.getBoundingClientRect().top) : null; }; return t('.ft-row__what') === t('.ft-row__op') && t('.ft-row__what') === t('.ft-row__value'); })()

steps.name: cross-top-right-wide
steps.probe: (() => { const row = document.querySelector('.st-filter .ft-row'); const rm = row.querySelector('.ft-row__remove'); const rr = row.getBoundingClientRect(); const rmr = rm ? rm.getBoundingClientRect() : null; if (!rmr) return false; return (rmr.top - rr.top) <= 8 && (rr.right - rmr.right) <= 8; })()

steps.name: panel-to-min
steps.eval: (() => { const s = document.querySelector('.st-filter + .fp-splitter') || document.querySelector('.fp-splitter'); if (!s) return 'no-splitter'; s.focus(); s.dispatchEvent(new KeyboardEvent('keydown', { key: 'Home', bubbles: true })); return true; })()

steps.name: layout-narrow
steps.probe: (() => { const row = document.querySelector('.st-filter .ft-row'); const q = (c) => row.querySelector(c); const top = (e) => e ? Math.round(e.getBoundingClientRect().top) : null; return JSON.stringify({ rowW: Math.round(row.getBoundingClientRect().width), whatTop: top(q('.ft-row__what')), opTop: top(q('.ft-row__op')), valueTop: top(q('.ft-row__value')) }); })()

steps.name: three-stacked-wide-tops
steps.probe: (() => { const row = document.querySelector('.st-filter .ft-row'); const t = (c) => { const e = row.querySelector(c); return e ? Math.round(e.getBoundingClientRect().top) : null; }; const w = t('.ft-row__what'); const o = t('.ft-row__op'); const v = t('.ft-row__value'); return o > w && v > o; })()

steps.name: value-wraps-whole
steps.probe: (() => { const row = document.querySelector('.st-filter .ft-row'); const t = (c) => { const e = row.querySelector(c); return e ? Math.round(e.getBoundingClientRect().top) : null; }; const vw = row.querySelector('.ft-row__value').getBoundingClientRect().width; return t('.ft-row__value') > t('.ft-row__what') && vw > 60; })()

steps.name: cross-top-right-narrow
steps.probe: (() => { const row = document.querySelector('.st-filter .ft-row'); const rm = row.querySelector('.ft-row__remove'); const rr = row.getBoundingClientRect(); const rmr = rm ? rm.getBoundingClientRect() : null; if (!rmr) return false; return (rmr.top - rr.top) <= 8 && (rr.right - rmr.right) <= 8; })()

steps.name: case-b-search
steps.probe: (() => { const s = document.querySelector('.st-filter + .fp-splitter') || document.querySelector('.fp-splitter'); const row = () => document.querySelector('.st-filter .ft-row'); const top = (e) => e ? Math.round(e.getBoundingClientRect().top) : -1; const caseB = () => { const r = row(); if (!r) return false; const w = r.querySelector('.ft-row__what'); const o = r.querySelector('.ft-row__op'); const v = r.querySelector('.ft-row__value'); return top(w) === top(o) && top(v) > top(w); }; for (let i = 0; i < 40; i += 1) { if (caseB()) { const r = row(); return JSON.stringify({ found: true, step: i, rowW: Math.round(r.getBoundingClientRect().width), whatTop: top(r.querySelector('.ft-row__what')), opTop: top(r.querySelector('.ft-row__op')), valueTop: top(r.querySelector('.ft-row__value')), crossTopRight: (() => { const rm = r.querySelector('.ft-row__remove'); const rr = r.getBoundingClientRect(); const rmr = rm ? rm.getBoundingClientRect() : null; return !!rmr && (rmr.top - rr.top) <= 8 && (rr.right - rmr.right) <= 8; })() }); } s.dispatchEvent(new KeyboardEvent('keydown', { key: 'ArrowRight', bubbles: true })); } return JSON.stringify({ found: false }); })()

steps.name: case-b-found
steps.probe: (() => { const row = () => document.querySelector('.st-filter .ft-row'); const top = (e) => e ? Math.round(e.getBoundingClientRect().top) : -1; const r = row(); if (!r) return false; const w = r.querySelector('.ft-row__what'); const o = r.querySelector('.ft-row__op'); const v = r.querySelector('.ft-row__value'); return top(w) === top(o) && top(v) > top(w); })()

steps.name: dark-arrows-and-switch
steps.probe: (() => { const sw = document.querySelector('.st-filter .ft-row .fv-mode'); const seg = sw ? sw.querySelector('.ui-btn') : null; const cs = seg ? getComputedStyle(seg) : null; const row = document.querySelector('.st-filter .ft-row'); return JSON.stringify({ theme: document.documentElement.dataset.theme, modeCount: row ? row.querySelectorAll('.fv-mode').length : -1, switchFont: cs ? cs.fontSize : null, switchPadTop: cs ? cs.paddingTop : null, rowBg: getComputedStyle(row).backgroundColor }); })()

steps.name: dark-layout-intact
steps.probe: (() => { const row = document.querySelector('.st-filter .ft-row'); if (!row) return false; const rm = row.querySelector('.ft-row__remove'); const rr = row.getBoundingClientRect(); const rmr = rm ? rm.getBoundingClientRect() : null; return document.documentElement.dataset.theme === 'dark' && row.querySelectorAll('.fv-mode').length === 1 && getComputedStyle(row).alignItems === 'flex-start' && !!rmr && (rmr.top - rr.top) <= 8 && (rr.right - rmr.right) <= 8; })()
